description: Run a read-only SPARQL SELECT query against lindas.admin.ch, the Swiss federal linked-data service. Useful graphs include <https://lindas.admin.ch/elcom/electricityprice> (energy prices), ELI legislation, the municipality register (ld.admin.ch/municipality/{BFS}), and cube.link statistical cubes. A top-level LIMIT of 100 is added if none is given and larger limits are clamped to 200; SERVICE (federation) and update operations are rejected; max 10000 characters.
name: query_lindas
title: SPARQL query on LINDAS
